<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern, the clear M+1 peak at ~5.6 % of the base peak matches the expected contribution from ^13C (≈1.1 % per carbon), indicating the presence of carbon. No characteristic 2 Da spacing or intensity ratios for Cl, Br, S, etc., are observed, so no other element can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
